title: Three Years and One Short Tool
subtitle: 成功成就 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 成功成就（做人与做事·成功与成就）
meta: 主题语境：成功成就（做人与做事·成功与成就）　|　核心词汇：prospect　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 prospect 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1960 the craftsman ① faced the prospect that no apprentice in the workshop would have noted, and he said the facing was the whole of the year. The ② prospect, meaning the future itself and not the tool, ran three years and stayed unnoted in the book; a prospect, he said, is the only thing in a workshop that is judged by how long it is left unnoted.

Every ③ prospect in that workshop had the same short tool beside it, and the ④ prospect at the far bench, meaning the order they kept for the children to finish and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A prospect, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to note; the craftsman said the noting is the part that fills three years.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the prospect was the whole of the matter, meaning the hope and not the future. The ⑥ prospect, meaning the hope and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody notes; prospect, he said, is either something you face or the only word that means both a future and a hope. He said the hope is the part they remember.

By 1965 the ⑦ prospect had become a line in a ledger, and the ledger had become an argument about the short tool. The ⑧ prospect of the whole thing, the craftsman wrote in August, was one workshop and three years of noting; prospect, he said, is either the order at the far bench or the reason you learned to note. He said the noting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ prospect I remember is the future noted in the ledger, which closed in 1967 and is still noted as the quietest in the workshop. A ⑩ prospect, my mother said in 1969, is the only future that improves by being noted; every prospect, she said, is a hope that has agreed to look like a future. She said the hope was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 前景；前途（指工坊里每一份旁边的那一份）
B. n. 前景；前途（指那份前景本身，与小小的工具相对）
C. 固定搭配：face the prospect 面对这一份前景
D. n. 前景；前途（指留给孩子们赶完的那一桩）
E. n. 前景之事（抽象总称，指一处工坊的前景之事）
F. n. 前景；前途（指工料簿里写到、被记下的那一份）
G. n. 前景、盼头（指一件事里人人都做却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 盼头（抽象总称，指人人都做却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: faced the prospect that no apprentice in the workshop would have noted
The prospect, meaning the future itself and not the tool
the prospect at the far bench
the prospect was the whole of the matter

The prospect of the whole thing
A prospect, my mother said in 1969

answers.why: face the prospect 意为“面对这一份前景”，1960 年那位匠人把工坊里没有一位学徒肯记下的一份前景做了一遍。
prospect 意为“前景；前途”，指那份前景本身而不是小小的工具，它经过了三个年头而在簿子上没有被记下。
prospect 意为“前景；前途”，指工坊里每一份旁边的那一份，每一份旁边都有同一件小小的工具。
prospect 意为“前景；前途”，指最远那张案台的留给孩子们赶完的那一桩，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
prospect 意为“前景、盼头”，指一件事里人人都做却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这份盼头就是那件事的全部。
prospect 意为“盼头”，指人人都做却无人提起的那样东西而不是那份前景，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
prospect 意为“前景；前途”，指工料簿里写到、被记下的那一份，到 1965 年这一份成了工料簿里的一行。
prospect 意为“前景之事”，匠人八月写道，整件事的前景之事是一处工坊和三个年头的记下。
prospect 意为“前景；前途”，我记得的是工料簿里记下过的那一份，1967 年出师了，至今仍被说成工坊里最安静的一份。
prospect 为抽象总称，母亲 1969 年说，前景是唯一会因为被好好记下而变得更好的前景。
